purpose: Four animated city-skin concept previews; not a catalog release

assets.name: Templar Dawnwatch
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one premium transparent-background city-skin sprite for Crown Lands, a painted medieval atlas strategy game. Create one magnificent Knights Templar-inspired fortified city, a complete compact walled settlement seen from an elevated three-quarter isometric view, front gate facing bottom center. Sophisticated hand-painted parchment-era illustration: fine ink outlines, painterly mineral pigments, crisp miniature architectural detail, believable masonry, no glossy 3D. Dominant ivory limestone and bone-white cloth, vivid restrained crimson crosses on white banners, dark warm slate roofs, small red-roofed houses. A tall square crusader keep with a chapel, concentric walls, six readable round towers, a grand front gate and an intimate market court. Clearly show multiple simple red equal-arm crosses on ivory hanging banners. Dramatic late-afternoon warm gold highlights, amber windows and two small braziers beside the front gate. Stately noble silhouette, readable at game icon scale. Keep grounded medieval architecture, with no giant magical floating objects, no knights or faces. Entire city fits fully in square canvas, centered, occupies about 88% of width and 86% of height, tiny natural stone/grass footprint closely hugging wall base. True alpha transparency everywhere beyond city silhouette. No broad terrain disc, no sky, no rectangular backdrop, no text, no title, no watermark, no border. Freeze flags in a graceful pose; animated light, sparks and banner layers will be added separately by the game.

assets.name: Hospitaller Night Sanctuary
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one premium transparent city-skin sprite for Crown Lands, painted medieval atlas strategy game. Create one magnificent Knights Hospitaller-inspired fortified city, complete compact walled settlement from elevated three-quarter isometric view, front gate bottom center. Hand-painted historical-fantasy miniature with fine ink outlines, mineral pigments, intricate readable masonry, no glossy 3D. Distinctive broad fortress-hospital complex, pale weathered limestone walls, charcoal-black roofs and black cloth banners bearing bold white crosses; two rich burgundy subsidiary pennants with white crosses. Large central chapel and long cloister wings, enclosed herb courtyards, round towers, broad arched gatehouse, many small amber-lit windows. Dominant black-and-ivory palette with warm bronze lantern accents. White eight-pointed cross motifs used sparingly as recognizable artistic inspiration from the order's later emblem. Architecture must feel different from a tall narrow fantasy castle: wide strong lower silhouette with a commanding chapel bell tower. Night-watch mood but naturally lit legible stone, silvery moonlit edges and warm lantern light, no background night sky. Two lanterns beside the front gate. Whole city centered, entirely inside square canvas, about 88% width and 86% height, minimal moss-and-stone footprint tightly hugging walls. True alpha transparency outside silhouette. No characters, no broad terrain disc, no sky, no text, labels, watermark or borders. Freeze banners in graceful poses; animated wisps, silver motes and lantern shimmer will be overlaid separately.

assets.name: Teutonic Frost Citadel
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one premium transparent city-skin sprite for Crown Lands, painted medieval atlas strategy game. Create a magnificent Teutonic Order-inspired fortified city, full compact settlement viewed elevated three-quarter isometric, front gate centered toward bottom. Exquisitely hand-painted fine-ink miniature, historical atlas illustration, mineral pigments, defined masonry and roof tiles, readable at small game size, no glossy 3D. White banners bearing bold BLACK equal-arm crosses, monumental northern Gothic fortress of pale gray stone with dark slate and muted blue roofs, a distinctive stepped rectangular central keep with narrow pointed gables and corner turrets, stern square gate towers, crenellated outer walls and close-packed Germanic timber houses. Very small amounts of snow settled naturally on roof ridges and wall ledges, frost-blue edge lighting and a few amber windows. Distinct austere broad geometric silhouette; cross motifs unmistakably black on white. Full city centered entirely in a square, ~88% width ~86% height. Tiny frosty earth footprint hugging walls, no large snowy landscape, no terrain disc. True transparent alpha outside the complete city. No horns on buildings, no fantasy spikes, no characters, no detached effects, no sky, no backdrop, no writing or labels or border. Snowfall, cold wind and glints are added separately as animation; keep source still and architectural.

assets.name: Santiago Emberward
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one premium transparent city-skin sprite for Crown Lands, painted medieval atlas strategy game. Create one magnificent Order of Santiago-inspired fortified Iberian city: complete compact walled settlement from elevated three-quarter isometric angle, front gate facing bottom center. Detailed hand-painted atlas miniature, fine ink outlines, mineral pigments, believable stone, crisp roof tiles, warm natural textures, no glossy 3D. Golden pale sandstone, ivory cloth and rich terracotta roofs, elegant square towers with red-tiled pyramidal caps, a tall central chapel-fortress and broad sunlit courtyards; warm Spanish architectural identity. Make the signature unmistakable: red sword-shaped cross of Santiago on large ivory banners, long downward pointed sword blade and decorative fleur-de-lis ends on the horizontal arms, distinctly unlike a simple equal-arm Templar cross. Gate banners must clearly repeat the red sword-cross; restrained scallop-shell stone carving above the gate. A few cypress trees inside walls, amber windows and warm braziers by the gate. Grand rich silhouette and exceptional painting quality, readable at game scale. Fully isolated city centered and entirely inside square canvas at ~88% width ~86% height, tiny ochre earth footprint hugging outer walls. True alpha transparency beyond city. No broad terrain disc, no sky, no background, no characters, no text, no labels or border. Do not paint detached particle trails: ember swirls and gold glints will be animated separately.
